data.Name: Drogon — HSE and environmental impact
data.Summary: Potential marine discharge and accidental spill risk in the Drogon area, identified ahead of detailed environmental assessment.
data.Description: Preliminary screening identifies cold-water coral habitats and sensitive benthic communities in the Drogon licence area. Produced water discharge limits, accidental spill scenarios, and subsea construction impacts are not yet quantified. No EIA or OSCAR spill modelling performed. This risk is flagged at DG1 as requiring full environmental impact assessment before DG2 concept selection.
